label: Comtrend GCA-6000 G.hn Ethernet over Coax adapter
description: G.hn Ethernet-over-coax adapter with a 1200 Mbps PHY: one 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and one F-type coax connector (built-in 100 MHz diplexer optional). Dark coax only - it cannot share a cable carrying live CATV/satellite; up to 32 nodes.
